title: Mardi Gras truck jobs and getting lost in the Rex parade
summary: Pleasure clubs hire bands on trucks; he and Son Johnson get drunk and march off the Rex route.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: And they would just, what, meander through the neighborhoods? Go through the neighborhoods?
No, they have a regular route.

You know one time I played a carnival parade, and we were supposed to follow Rex. Yeah. And the guy, the president of the club, it was a white club too, and they gave us a fifth of whiskey. So I was standing next, I was marching with a guy named Son Johnson, have you heard of Son Johnson? Yeah. He was on this side of me, and I remember playing the horn, take me a drink, play the horn, give him the, because he couldn't carry the whiskey and play his horn too, because you have to have two hands to play the saxophone. So we messed around and drinking all that liquor, and we got drunk in the parade. And the band made a turn, and we kept straight. We kept going straight. And then we heard people behind us clapping, and we didn't hear any drums, we didn't hear another horn. So when we looked around, we didn't know where the band turned.
We just kept going. The whole Rex parade went one way, and we were going another way, just Son Johnson and me.
